gaps.sentence: We should make the ___ of the good weather.
gaps.explanation: 'make the most of' = get the maximum benefit from.

gaps.sentence: I wish I ___ told him the truth at the time.
gaps.explanation: 'wish + past perfect' for regret about the past.

gaps.sentence: The car needs ___ before we leave.
gaps.explanation: 'need + -ing' = need to be + participle: needs cleaning.

gaps.sentence: The letters ___ delivered every morning at eight.
The findings will be published in ___ course.
gaps.hint: in ___ course = at the right time
gaps.explanation: 'In due course' = eventually, when the time is right.

gaps.sentence: She's the woman ___ helped me find the station.
We're going to ___ our flight if we don't hurry.
gaps.hint: be too late for a plane
gaps.explanation: 'miss a flight/train/bus' = arrive too late for it.

gaps.sentence: There were ___ people at the concert than last year.
